title: Review
description: Output of Phase 2 (architectural tier only; the standard tier replaces the reviewer fan-out with constraints.md injection). DBA, DevOps, and SecOps each write their block via per-agent shards the orchestrator merges.

secops.description: A SecOps finding can occupy three locations, and the property requirement reaches only two of them. concerns[] requires must_satisfy and vulnerabilities[] requires remediation, both refused at SubagentStop. compliance_flags[] is UNREACHED: its items subschema has no required list at all, so a VETO recorded as {verdict: VETO, concerns: [], vulnerabilities: [], compliance_flags: [{}]} validates SILENT, with no statute, no concern and no action - measured through the shipped hook, with the pre-change schemas as the non-zero control. That channel is named here rather than guarded: guarding it needs its own cost analysis against already-written compliance rows and is not this change's business. The set is quantified over LOCATIONS a blocking finding can occupy, taken from the artifact contract in agents/secops.md, so a fourth location added later is visibly missing rather than silently absent.

statute.description: # CUSTOMIZE: the regulation or policy this concern maps to for your domain (e.g. GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, an internal data-handling policy). Free-form so it fits any jurisdiction.

remediation.description: This field KEEPS its name and changes its contract: what a correct fix must SATISFY, stated as a property carrying the observation that decides it ('the endpoint must be rate-limited low enough that credential stuffing and bulk scraping are not economical, measured by <observation: N requests from one source inside M seconds are rejected before the handler runs>'), or, where an authority outside you fixed the value, that value stated literally with its source named ('the webhook signature must be verified with the provider's HMAC-SHA256 scheme, per the provider's webhook docs'). Not a mechanism: 'wrap it with the global rate-limit middleware' names one implementation, forecloses the others, and cannot be checked without reading that middleware. A mechanism you weighed goes in rationale_not_checked. THE EMPTY STRING SATISFIES this field: the walker implements no minLength, and 17 of 229 already-written vulnerability rows carry no remediation at all (info 9, low 4, medium 4; ZERO of the 3 critical and ZERO of the 26 high), so '' is what a no-remediation row will become rather than a refusal.

rationale_not_checked.description: OPTIONAL, and never in any required list. The non-binding landing spot for a candidate mechanism you weighed in order to test a property's COST or falsify its necessity. No downstream role owes this field an action.

severity.description: This schema is the single source of truth for concern severity. The canonical panel vocabulary is blocker|major|nit (DBA/DevOps/Design emit these); SecOps's CVE-style critical|high|medium|low|info is accepted alongside it so a SecOps concern (e.g. severity 'low') validates cleanly. Distinct from the knowledge_drift_claims severity field.

must_satisfy.description: What a correct fix must BE TRUE OF, carrying in itself the observation whose outcome decides whether it is met - never HOW to make it true. A mechanism you weighed goes in rationale_not_checked. (a) WHERE A MISSING PROPERTY IS REFUSED, all three locations: this field on Phase 2 concerns[], and remediation on SecOps vulnerabilities[]. NOT on SecOps compliance_flags[], whose items subschema has no required list at all - a VETO recorded as {verdict: VETO, concerns: [], vulnerabilities: [], compliance_flags: [{}]} validates SILENT, with no statute, no concern and no action, measured through the shipped hook. NOT on any Phase 4 peer-review artifact (#38). (b) THE ENFORCEMENT RECORD IS DATED AND SCOPED BY DEPLOYMENT MODE, never by repository identity. WINDOW: measured 2026-08-21. POPULATION: one machine's ~/.claude/projects transcript corpus, 1638 files / 353,907 lines across 8 repositories. FINDING: 56 genuine blocks, every one of them in a project that dispatches BARE agent names from local .claude/agents/*.md files; ZERO across roughly 635 plugin-namespaced dispatches in six repositories, one of them an adopting project with 365 of them. RE-DERIVATION: count messages whose message.content is a plain string beginning 'Stop hook feedback:\nPipeline artifact failed schema validation', group by project directory, cross-tabulate against recorded Task subagent_type values; and run the four-cell agent_type fixture ('secops', 'SecOps', 'pipeline:secops', 'agent-pipeline:secops') against the shipped hook. The installed plugin with namespaced names is the shipping default, so read this as a dated record and not as a warranty for your deployment. Filed as #66; the correct outcome for #66 is that somebody fixes it, on which day this paragraph becomes false and a silence has no event that notices. (c) THE FAIL-OPEN DEGRADATIONS, five of them: the enforced half degrades to nothing when node is absent, when the plugin root is unset, when the active issue is unresolvable, when the artifact's mtime exceeds 30 minutes, and - dominantly, and this is the one that screens off the other four - when the stopping agent's type does not match an AGENT_RULES key (validate-pipeline-artifact.mjs:93 for the keys, :654-656 for the lookup and its early return). (d) THE EMPTY STRING SATISFIES. The walker implements no minLength and the requirement cannot be conditioned on severity, so '' is the cheapest value that satisfies this field. Measured where the gate fires: 17 of 229 already-written vulnerability rows carry no remediation - info 9, low 4, medium 4, and ZERO of the 3 critical and ZERO of the 26 high. (e) THE ARCHIVE RESIDUAL. What you write here is copied verbatim into knowledge/issue-archive/<n>.json, which IS committed, and that copy runs through the absolute-path redactor in knowledge-store.mjs. A property that OPENS with a route is rewritten: origin/main today carries LEADING_SPAN (knowledge-store.mjs:147), which replaces the leading path token only and leaves the prose after it standing; the earlier ABSOLUTE_VALUE form replaced the WHOLE value, prose and all. The invariant true under BOTH forms, and the only one to rely on, is that a LEADING path token does not survive into the durable record - so put the route mid-sentence or the archived property loses its subject. Check which form is live rather than trusting this sentence: grep -n 'ABSOLUTE_VALUE\|LEADING_SPAN' plugins/pipeline/scripts/knowledge-store.mjs. Because that copy is verbatim and public, never paste credential material into this field. (f) THE NEIGHBOUR LIMIT. This annotation warrants nothing beyond its own field: nothing about compliance_flags[], which stays unguarded by design; nothing about the severity enum above it; nothing about agentBlock's own required list, which this change does not touch.

rationale_not_checked.description: OPTIONAL, and never in any required list, in any of the three subschemas that carry it. The non-binding landing spot for a candidate mechanism you weighed in order to test a property's COST or falsify its necessity - which the guardrail rule asks you to do. No downstream role owes this field an action, and a fix that ignores it is not thereby wrong. Keeping it separate is what lets must_satisfy stay a property.

notes.description: Free-text reasoning. String preferred; an array of strings is accepted (agents emit both in practice).
